{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "190c081afe228cf1970f0cd71e06071d7513aeb64c5fbae51ca896e94ee6021a",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a real normed vector space E, q : R → R → E and flux : E → E, requires interval integrability of every spatial slice of q, interval integrability of every temporal slice of flux composed with q, and the identity ∫_a^b q(x,t) dx − ∫_a^b q(x,s) dx = ∫_s^t [flux(q(a,τ)) − flux(q(b,τ))] dτ for every real a,b,s,t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specializes E to R and imposes this integral conservation identity and both integrability requirements globally, including negative times and times after T.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "AddCommMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne",
      "meaning": "Projects the additive monoid with one structure from a commutative additive monoid with one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Helps supply the numeral one in the differentiability order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "AddMonoidWithOne.toOne",
      "meaning": "Projects the distinguished element one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies one in ENat for the order-one differentiability requirement.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "All listed properties must hold for the same existential witnesses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Projects the semiring structure from a commutative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in constructing the finite differentiability index one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "ContDiff",
      "meaning": "A differentiability predicate indexed by WithTop ENat. At an embedded order n it requires a Taylor series up to that order. At the outer top it requires a Taylor series up to outer top whose coefficient functions of every natural-number degree are analytic on neighborhoods of every point.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires flux to be C¹ on R. The initial profile uses the outer top of WithTop ENat, the analytic order, so its requirement is stronger than merely C∞.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "Continuous",
      "meaning": "Continuity of a function between the specified topological spaces.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires continuity on all of R of x ↦ q(x,t) separately for each t with 0 ≤ t < T.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed field structure and derives nontriviality from dense norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar-field structure needed by ContDiff.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "ENat",
      "meaning": "Natural numbers with an additional top element, defined as WithTop Nat.",
      "effect_on_target": "Distinguishes the infinite differentiability index inside ENat from the additional outer top in WithTop ENat.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two elements of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses pointwise equality with an affine function in the negated clause and exact equality in the conservation identity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over the specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts existence of flux, q, T, ξ, qL and qR; also binds the affine coefficients inside a negation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Filter.Tendsto",
      "meaning": "The image of the source filter under the function is bounded above by the target filter in the filter order.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses the two finite one-sided limits of the spatial profile at time T.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "The addition operation provided by a heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here it is real addition in a·u+b.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "The multiplication operation provided by a heterogeneous multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here it is real multiplication in a·u.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the normed vector-space structure of an inner-product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies R with its real normed vector-space structure for differentiability and integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "LE.le",
      "meaning": "The non-strict order relation supplied by an order instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses 0 ≤ t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "The strict order relation supplied by an order instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses 0 < T, t < T and qR < qL.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "NonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoidWithOne",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative additive monoid, one and natural-number casts from a nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in supplying the finite differentiability order one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, commutative additive group and induced pseudometric while forgetting norm separation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible underlying structures for real normed-space instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Not",
      "meaning": "Negation: a proposition implies False.",
      "effect_on_target": "Excludes the existence of real a,b making flux(u)=a·u+b for every real u.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal using the selected instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the differentiability order one and real zero for the initial time and time inequalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "One.toOfNat1",
      "meaning": "Interprets the literal 1 as the distinguished one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the flux differentiability order the finite value one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in supplying the usual real topology for continuity and limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Equips an RCLike field with its real inner-product structure and associated real normed-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specializes to R as a vector space over R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All spatial and temporal coordinates, state values, flux values, affine coefficients and limit values are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field equipped with density of its norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar structure for real differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Real-number addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines addition in the affine expression.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Real.instLE",
      "meaning": "The usual non-strict order on real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Includes time zero in the continuity interval.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The usual strict order on real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires a positive T, excludes T from the continuity interval, and orders the right limit below the left limit.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Real-number multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the product in the excluded affine representation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "Real.instPreorder",
      "meaning": "The inferred preorder structure on R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the order used to form the open left and right rays at ξ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The RCLike structure on R, with identity real part, zero imaginary part and the usual complete real normed-field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real inner-product and normed-space instances; it introduces no complex-valued variables.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "Real zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the initial time and lower time bound.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The usual additive group of R with its norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real differentiability, subtraction and integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric structure with distance |x−y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes continuity and the two limits statements in the ordinary Euclidean topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations and required laws of a semiring while forgetting multiplication associativity as a structural requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in constructing the numeral one in ENat.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "Set.Iio",
      "meaning": "The set of elements strictly less than its endpoint.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts the left-limit approach to x < ξ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Set.Ioi",
      "meaning": "The set of elements strictly greater than its endpoint.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts the right-limit approach to ξ < x.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Top.top",
      "meaning": "The distinguished greatest element of a type with a top instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the outer top of WithTop ENat for the initial-profile regularity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the topology of a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the topology in continuity and neighborhood filters.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "WithTop",
      "meaning": "Adds a distinguished top element to a type, represented by Option with embedded elements represented by some.",
      "effect_on_target": "WithTop ENat contains finite orders, the embedded infinite order, and a separate outer top.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "WithTop.one",
      "meaning": "Defines one in WithTop α as the embedded one of α.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the flux order is embedded finite one, not either top element.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "WithTop.top",
      "meaning": "Defines the added top element as Option.none.",
      "effect_on_target": "The initial profile uses this outer top, triggering the analytic branch of ContDiff.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the literal 0 as the distinguished zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the initial time and time lower bound real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "instCommSemiringENat",
      "meaning": "The commutative semiring structure on extended natural numbers, inherited from WithTop Nat.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the underlying one used for the order-one differentiability index.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary addition as heterogeneous addition with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the addition in a·u+b as real addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary multiplication as heterogeneous multiplication with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets a·u as a real product.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "nhds",
      "meaning": "The neighborhood filter at a point of the specified topological space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary neighborhoods of qL and qR and, through nhdsWithin, neighborhoods of ξ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "nhdsWithin",
      "meaning": "The infimum of the neighborhood filter at a point and the principal filter of the restricting set.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the approach filters at ξ restricted respectively to the strictly left and strictly right rays.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Projects the subtraction and negation structure of an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies subtraction for the conservation identity and oriented integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "The subtraction operation supplied by a heterogeneous subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses the difference of spatial integrals and the left-boundary flux minus the right-boundary flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "Integrability on both half-open intervals (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the supplied measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires integrability between any two finite endpoints regardless of their order, for every specified spatial and temporal slice.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Projects the distinguished measure from a measure-space instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the real volume measure for all integrability conditions and integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A commutative additive group with a compatible norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Constrains the generic codomain of LocalDef001; the target uses its standard real instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed additive-group structure while forgetting commutativity as a structural requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies structures needed for subtraction and integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides additive operations used in the integral identity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive group with its extended nonnegative norm and compatible additive-monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the norm structure used to express integrability of real-valued functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A vector-space structure over a normed field compatible with the given seminorm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real differentiation and vector-valued integration, specialized here to real-valued functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The inferred canonical measure-space instance on R, whose volume is the usual real volume measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses Lebesgue measure for the spatial and temporal integrals; its construction and normalization are not expanded in the supplied body.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The usual field operations on R together with its norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real scalar arithmetic and the normed-field structure used throughout.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Projects the pseudometric structure of a seminormed commutative additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible metric and topological structures for the integrability predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toSub",
      "meaning": "Projects the subtraction operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real subtraction in the specialized conservation identity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary subtraction as heterogeneous subtraction with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects subtraction notation to the real subtraction operation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "intervalIntegral",
      "meaning": "The integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a], each using the supplied restricted measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes every integral oriented: reversing its endpoints reverses its sign, and equal endpoints give zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "There exists a flux function flux : R → R.",
      "There exists a state function q : R → R → R, written q(x,t), with spatial argument first and temporal argument second.",
      "There exist real numbers T, ξ, qL and qR, representing a positive time, a spatial location, a left limiting state and a right limiting state.",
      "The witnesses occur in the order flux, q, T, ξ, qL, qR; later witnesses may be chosen depending on earlier ones. All conjuncts concern this single tuple.",
      "The excluded affine representation existentially quantifies real coefficients a,b and universally quantifies u ∈ R.",
      "The spatial integrability requirement universally quantifies a,b,t ∈ R. The temporal flux integrability requirement universally quantifies x,s,t ∈ R.",
      "The conservation identity universally quantifies a,b,s,t ∈ R, with τ the temporal integration variable and x the spatial integration variable.",
      "The continuity requirement universally quantifies t ∈ R, conditional on 0 ≤ t and t < T.",
      "The outer-top regularity definition existentially quantifies a Taylor-series family p and universally quantifies its degree i ∈ N."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "There are no external hypotheses or universally prescribed initial data or flux. All required properties are conjuncts inside the existential statement."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "flux is continuously differentiable on all of R.",
      "There are no a,b ∈ R such that flux(u)=a·u+b for every u ∈ R.",
      "For every a,b,t ∈ R, x ↦ q(x,t) is interval integrable between a and b.",
      "For every x,s,t ∈ R, τ ↦ flux(q(x,τ)) is interval integrable between s and t.",
      "For every a,b,s,t ∈ R, ∫_a^b q(x,t) dx − ∫_a^b q(x,s) dx = ∫_s^t [flux(q(a,τ)) − flux(q(b,τ))] dτ.",
      "The initial profile x ↦ q(x,0) satisfies ContDiff at the outer top of WithTop ENat: it admits the specified Taylor-series family with every coefficient function analytic on neighborhoods of all real points. This is the analytic regularity condition, and in particular implies smoothness.",
      "T > 0.",
      "For every t ∈ [0,T), the function x ↦ q(x,t) is continuous on all of R.",
      "lim_{x→ξ, x<ξ} q(x,T)=qL and lim_{x→ξ, x>ξ} q(x,T)=qR.",
      "qR < qL, so the profile at time T has distinct finite one-sided limits forming a downward spatial jump at ξ."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "R carries its usual field operations, order, absolute-value norm and Euclidean topology.",
      "Integrals use the canonical real volume measure, conventionally Lebesgue measure.",
      "For real endpoints a,b, interval integrability means integrability on both (a,b] and (b,a].",
      "The oriented integral ∫_a^b f is defined as the measure integral over (a,b] minus that over (b,a].",
      "The left and right limits use the neighborhood filter at ξ intersected with the principal filters of (−∞,ξ) and (ξ,∞), respectively.",
      "Non-affineness is global on the entire real state line, rather than restricted to the values attained by q.",
      "ENat is WithTop N. Consequently, the outer top in WithTop ENat is distinct from the embedded infinite order used for ordinary C∞ regularity."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "There exist a globally C¹, globally non-affine real flux function flux, a real-valued function q defined for every real space and time coordinate, a positive real time T, a real spatial point ξ, and real states qL>qR with the following simultaneous properties. Every spatial slice of q is integrable on every bounded interval, every temporal slice of flux(q) is integrable on every bounded interval, and for all real a,b,s,t the change from time s to time t of the oriented spatial integral of q from a to b equals the oriented temporal integral from s to t of flux(q(a,τ))−flux(q(b,τ)). The initial spatial profile satisfies the analytic outer-top ContDiff condition. Every spatial profile at a time 0≤t<T is continuous everywhere. At time T the left and right spatial limits at ξ exist and equal qL and qR respectively, with the right limit strictly smaller than the left."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "This is an existence assertion for one flux and one state function. It does not assert the result for every non-affine flux or for arbitrary prescribed initial data.",
    "All spatial and temporal coordinates in the integral conservation condition range over R without endpoint-order restrictions. In particular, this condition holds before time zero and after T.",
    "The explicit spatial regularity before T is only continuity of each fixed-time slice; no joint continuity, temporal differentiability or classical pointwise PDE is explicitly required.",
    "The initial regularity index is outer top, which selects analytic regularity rather than merely infinitely differentiable regularity.",
    "The assertion includes no entropy inequality, convexity or strict convexity of flux, uniqueness, shock trajectory, shock speed or explicit Rankine–Hugoniot condition.",
    "Global non-affineness does not require the flux to be non-affine on the actual range of q.",
    "The limit clauses do not specify q(ξ,T). Distinct one-sided limits imply discontinuity at ξ regardless of that value.",
    "The statement requires no spatial continuity at or after T and does not exclude additional discontinuities at time T.",
    "Integrability is on bounded intervals, not necessarily on the whole real line. No global boundedness, decay, compact support or finite total mass is required.",
    "The temporal integrability condition applies to flux(q(x,τ)), not directly to q(x,τ). Joint measurability is not explicitly required.",
    "Since T>0, the quantified continuity interval [0,T) is nonempty. Since ξ is real, both strict one-sided approach filters are nontrivial, so the limit requirements are not vacuous through an empty approach domain.",
    "Degenerate intervals give trivial integral identities, but the universal quantifiers also require the identities and integrability for every nondegenerate finite interval."
  ],
  "ambiguities": [
    "Several external-frontier definitions are not fully expanded: in particular, nhds has an opaque wrapped projection, Real.measureSpace is shown only as inferInstance, and the ContDiff matcher and Taylor-series and analyticity predicates are not defined further. Their standard mathematical interpretations are used above; the packet alone does not expose their full foundational implementation or the construction and normalization of real volume."
  ]
}
